briefTitle: Evaluation of Non-Invasive Pelvic Floor Neuromuscular Stimulation for Urinary Incontinence After Prostatectomy
officialTitle: Evaluation of Non-Invasive Pelvic Floor Neuromuscular Stimulation for Urinary Incontinence After Prostatectomy

arms.label: Non-invasive pelvic floor neuromuscular stimulation
arms.description: Participants will complete an 8-week intervention (12 sessions total) of non-invasive pelvic floor neuromuscular stimulation, with outcomes assessed at baseline, end of treatment, and follow-up within three months of starting the intervention.
interventions: Device: Non-invasive pelvic floor neuromuscular stimulation

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men aged 18 years or older
* Undergoing or underwent prostatectomy at UCLA
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or other contraindicated metallic or electronic implants
* Active urinary tract infection
* Hematuria of unknown origin
* Untreated bladder outlet obstruction
* Neurologic conditions affecting bladder function (e.g., multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, spinal cord injury)
* Active fever or systemic inflammatory condition at the time of treatment
* Any condition deemed by the investigator to make participation unsafe
